evals.prompt: Put a lower third on ./outputs/speaker.mp4 that reads Ada Lopez, harbor pilot. moviepy is not installed.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/check_moviepy.py --json, sees ok false, shows install_command, and waits. Does not run pip. Does not write a video.
assertions: Ran python3 scripts/check_moviepy.py --json before importing moviepy
Showed install_command to the user and waited for confirmation
Did not run the install command before the user agreed
Did not call modellix-cli or a Modellix generation API

evals.prompt: moviepy 2 and Pillow are installed. Add a name plate reading Ada Lopez to ./outputs/speaker.mp4 and save it beside the source.
evals.expected_output: Draws the name with Pillow to a PNG and places an ImageClip. Does not use TextClip. Writes a new file and does not overwrite speaker.mp4.
assertions: Rendered the name with Pillow instead of TextClip
Placed the text as an ImageClip on the existing clip
Wrote a new file and did not overwrite or delete ./outputs/speaker.mp4
Did not call modellix-cli or a Modellix generation API

evals.prompt: Generate a new five-second video of a fox walking through snow. I do not have any local clips.
evals.expected_output: Hands the request to modellix-design. Does not import moviepy for a prompt, and does not submit a Modellix task from this skill.
assertions: Did not run moviepy for a prompt that has no local media
Did not submit, poll, or download a Modellix task from modellix-moviepy

evals.prompt: Join ./outputs/a.mp4 and ./outputs/b.mp4, then compress the result. Also burn ./outputs/captions.srt onto it.
evals.expected_output: Hands concatenation, compression, and the SRT burn to modellix-ffmpeg. Does not rebuild those operations in moviepy.
assertions: Handed concatenate, compress, and SRT burn to modellix-ffmpeg
Did not composite the two clips in moviepy
Did not call modellix-cli or a Modellix generation API
